bindings: independently identified products with explicit roles
consumer: verifyArtifactBundle requires the consumer's exact expected bundle identity, rehashes all immediate dependencies/products, replays descriptor registration, validates supported products/toolchain dependencies and binds claim subjects/profile. Claim evidence replay is opt-in through independently selected checker implementations.
claims: No claim is inferred from product presence. Empty ClaimSets are permitted for unassured artifacts. Preservation and release acceptance remain false after an integrity-only check.
profileEnvironment: Typed ProfileEnvironment/ExtensionSet decoding and exact declared-input replay are required during bundle verification. Complete observed closure and hermetic execution remain unproved.
remaining: Complete direct JS/Wasm service and Rust producer routing, plus release-policy consumers
Observe and bind complete ProfileEnvironment and toolchain closures
PublicApiIR-derived direct-JS declarations and OriginGraph-derived maps
Actual claim checkers and assured release policy
No global preservation, conformance or promotion claim
production: The checked TypeScript builder publishes a descriptor, profile, empty ClaimSet and ArtifactBundle containing the actual TS/JS/declaration/map/ABI outputs. The archive independently verifies all V5 products and one BuildAction binding per observed execution.
